test_title: PYST 57: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following launched the AIKosha in 2025?

options.text: Union Minister for Health & Family Welfare
Union Minister for Electronics & Information Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Minister for Electronics & Information Technology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• AIKosha, an artificial intelligence-powered platform, was launched in 2025 by the **Union Minister for Electronics & Information Technology** to enhance government-citizen interaction and improve public service delivery.
 
• The platform leverages AI to provide real-time solutions to citizens' queries and support various government initiatives.
 
• AIKosha aims to improve transparency, accountability, and efficiency in governance by integrating advanced machine learning and natural language processing technologies.
 
• The initiative is part of India’s Digital India mission and emphasizes the use of cutting-edge technology to empower citizens and streamline government services.
 
• AIKosha was conceptualized to ensure seamless communication between the government and citizens, making information more accessible and reducing bureaucratic delays.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digital India Initiative:**

 
 
• Launched by the Government of India to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• Focus areas include e-Governance, digital infrastructure, and citizen-centric services.
 
• AIKosha aligns with the goals of Digital India by leveraging AI to simplify governance and enhance service delivery.
